title: Offset in a table of fields
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a type, let $h$ be a finite list of elements of $\Gamma$, and let $es$ be a finite list of finite lists of finite lists of elements of $\Gamma$. Suppose every entry $e$ of $es$ is nonempty. For every natural number $j$, the offset in the table formed from header $h$ and entries $es$, through the first $j$ entries, is $|h|+1$ plus the sum over those entries of the length of their fields joined by single separators, plus one separator per entry.
hypotheses_covered: $es$ is a finite list of entries, each a finite list of finite lists over $\Gamma$
